reasoning_traces.think:
The core duality in football's passing game lies in its dual nature: it simultaneously offers high reward (gain) and high risk (exposure). This creates a dynamic equilibrium where the offense must optimize for both metrics. The defense, in turn, operates under a cognitive load that scales with the perceived threat of the pass. When the defense fails to manage this load—either through poor anticipation or misalignment—it opens vulnerabilities that the offense exploits. The balance between these forces determines the outcome of the play. In GSI, this manifests as a probabilistic model of pass success conditioned on defensive positioning and offensive intent. In GSE, it becomes a recursive state machine where each action modifies the next possible move set based on evolving risk profiles.
